BENIGN.description: Safe, legitimate, non-malicious communications including legitimate OTPs, bank alerts, delivery notifications, and verified service updates.

SUSPICIOUS_SPAM.description: Unsolicited commercial messages, telemarketing, nuisance promotions, and unverified commercial offers without credential theft or severe threat payloads.

MALICIOUS.description: Severe security threats, phishing, smishing, credential theft, reverse OTP fraud, fake KYC/PAN suspension, electricity scams, UPI collect fraud, APK droppers, and extortion.

primary_types.description: Intent classification categories independent of security status

threat_vectors.description: Multi-label threat taxonomy for explainable security alerts
